svg.aria-label: Dot plot of task completion time. Super-agent: median 12.4, p95 15.7 minutes. Without pass-through: 12.6 and 15.5. Single session with subagent tool, delegate-first prompt: 13.8 and 29.0. Neutral prompt: 20.4 and 29.5.
